material:
# stage build chain, variant A
PREFIX ?= /opt/stage
CHANNEL ?= beta
STAGE_DIR := $(PREFIX)/drop
TOOLS = fetch $(EXTRA)
EXTRA = decode
TOOLS += launch
override MODE := quiet
MODE := loud
NAME = $(strip $(subst -,_, stage-one ))
FIRST = $(firstword $(TOOLS))
OBJS := $(patsubst %.c,%.o,a.c b.c)
define HOOK
import sys
print("hook")
endef
.PHONY: all fetch decode launch report prep
.DEFAULT_GOAL := all
all: launch report
launch: decode | prep
	pwsh -NoProfile -Command "Write-Host $(MODE) $(word 2,$(TOOLS))"
decode: fetch
	python3 -c "print('$(CHANNEL)')"
fetch: prep
	@echo fetch $(STAGE_DIR) \
	  $(FIRST)
report: fetch
	node -e "console.log('$(NAME) $(CHANNEL)')"
report: CHANNEL := gamma
prep:
	@echo prep
generator_cmd: python3 -I tests/data/script_fixtures/mkflow_gen.py tests/data/script_fixtures/  (stdlib str writer; variant B = A with `CHANNEL := stable` ahead of `CHANNEL ?= beta`, `all: launch report` -> `all: report launch`, no .DEFAULT_GOAL)
oracle_cmd: cd tests/data/script_fixtures/ && python3 -I mkflow_oracle.py recipe mkflow_variant_a.mk report  (GNU make 4.4.1 -n --trace / --eval $(info ..) / -qp)
